title: Recording: Must Do Something About It by Wings | 1976
content:
Studio Two, Abbey Road Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Peter Henderson

Wings continued work on the Wings At The Speed Of Sound song ‘Must Do Something About It’ on 6 January 1976.

They had recorded the backing track the day before, but the session ended early after news broke of the death of former Beatles roadie Mal Evans.

Jimmy McCulloch added electric guitar, Joe English replaced the drum machine with percussion including a cowbell, and Paul McCartney attempted a lead vocal part. However, he remained dissatisfied with the results, and the song was set aside for another day. It was eventually sung by English.
